detail.callback:
f%Classic Tetris: control the falling blocks, clear lines, and earn points.
The game is divided into <fg:bright_green>Normal Mode</fg> and <fg:bright_red>Challenge Mode</fg>.

<fg:bright_green>Normal Mode</fg>:
No special rules—just try to achieve the highest score possible!

<fg:bright_red>Challenge Mode</fg>:
Implemented with reference to the NES version. As the level increases, the blocks fall faster, but at the same time you earn more points.
Push yourself to your limit!
